+fire(net : Net, m : Counter, tid : str) : Counter
No LLM. evaluate(): deterministic rules of the ERDIS call,
each with the article it comes from. replay(): fires the
enabled transitions of the workflow net that the student's
facts and the reference date say have happened; the enabled
transitions of the final marking are the next steps.
The facts are neither stored nor logged.
One model: the workflow net, the BPMN file
of the guide are all derived from STEPS.
language, prompts, LLM providers, verifier, answer service
Pydantic models of the API contract
libraries and systems outside the repository
